fields.help: Address of the JSON endpoint (GET).

fields.name: params
fields.help: Query parameters sent with every request.

fields.name: pagination
fields.help: Optional: how to reach later pages (page number or next link). JSON object, one of: mode page: param, start, max_pages; mode next_link: path (required), max_pages.

fields.name: mapping
fields.help: Where each field is in the response.

fields.name: list
fields.help: Dotted path, in the whole response, to the array of items. Empty when the response itself is the array.

fields.name: title
fields.help: Title. Dotted path into each item (for example buyer.name or tags.0).

fields.name: url
fields.help: Link to the notice, or an id for url_template. Dotted path into each item (for example buyer.name or tags.0).

fields.name: url_template
fields.help: Build the link from the url value: an address with {value} where the value goes.

fields.name: date
fields.help: Published date. Dotted path into each item (for example buyer.name or tags.0).

fields.name: deadline
fields.help: Deadline. Dotted path into each item (for example buyer.name or tags.0).

fields.name: organisation
fields.help: Issuing organisation. Dotted path into each item (for example buyer.name or tags.0).

fields.name: snippet
fields.help: Short description (HTML is stripped). Dotted path into each item (for example buyer.name or tags.0).

fields.name: extra
fields.help: Other fields to keep: label -> dotted path.

fields.name: max_bytes
fields.help: Largest response accepted, in bytes.

fields.name: queries
fields.help: Search queries, one request each per run.

fields.name: domains
fields.help: Only keep results from these domains (site: filter).

fields.name: recency_days
fields.help: Only results from roughly the last N days.

fields.name: count
fields.help: Results per query (1-20).

fields.name: sender
fields.help: Sender address, or a pattern with * and ? (for example *@alerts.example.org).

fields.name: subject_pattern
fields.help: Only emails whose subject matches this pattern (* and ?; case-insensitive).

fields.name: parse_mode
fields.help: links: each link in the email is an item. message: one item per email (its subject, and its first matching link).

fields.name: link_pattern
fields.help: Only links matching this pattern (* and ?), for example https://board.example/tender/*.

fields.name: min_title_chars
fields.help: links mode: skip links whose text is shorter.

fields.name: folder
fields.help: Mailbox folder to read.

fields.name: since_days
fields.help: Only look at emails received in the last N days.

fields.name: max_messages
fields.help: Read at most this many new emails per run.

fields.name: require_authenticated
fields.help: Only trust emails the receiving server marked dmarc=pass or dkim=pass for the sender's domain (guards against forged senders). The server is identified by BK_INGEST_AUTHSERV_ID; without it the source does not run.

fields.name: collector
fields.help: Which built-in custom collector to run: demo_fictional, jsonld_events, umucyo_awards, umucyo_plans

fields.name: options
fields.help: Settings for the chosen collector (see its form). demo_fictional: none. jsonld_events: list_url (required), pagination_pattern, first_page, max_pages, max_items. umucyo_awards: list_url (required), pagination_pattern, first_page, max_pages, max_items, date_formats, amounts, selectors (required), detail. umucyo_plans: list_url (required), pagination_pattern, first_page, max_pages, max_items, date_formats, amounts, selectors (required), page, quarter_basis.
